title: Procurement & Supply Chain Process Design — Supplier Tiers and Quality Controls
result: Eight-person team and two-tier supplier model
summary: Led procurement across transportation and tour operations while formalizing supplier agreements and quality controls.
context: Vehicle leasing and tour guide services needed consistent supplier coverage, purchasing agreements and a way to handle quality claims.
decisions: I led an eight-person team and built a two-tier supplier system. We put agreements in place covering 80% of spend and organized quality control procedures and claims tracking.
outcome: The role covered RMB 72 million in direct spend. The 2017 result was RMB 720,000 in cost savings.
